title: 第12章 猎影蛛
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
雾气越来越浓。

    陈峰握着工兵铲，贴着沿街建筑的外墙一步一步朝西侧摸过去。

    前方的路面碎的不成样子，碎石和杂草交织在一起。

    陈峰每踩一步都得小心翼翼，生怕弄出太大动静。

    走大概六七十米，前方的浓雾中一个模糊的轮廓渐渐浮了出来，是一栋两层的小楼。

    整栋小楼比周围的居民楼矮了一截，外墙刷过的白漆大片大片的剥落，露出底下灰扑扑的水泥。

    陈峰放缓脚步，眯着眼透过护目镜往前看。

    只见小楼的门口上方挂着一块横匾，匾额歪斜着只剩一头还挂在钉子上，另一头垂下来在微风中轻轻晃荡。

    匾面上的字被风雨侵蚀的缺笔少划，但依稀还能辨认出几个字。

    【刘氏武馆】

    陈峰心跳微微加速。

    找到了，日记里那个中学生提到的武馆就是这里。

    他上前走了几步，伴随距离的接近，这栋小楼的轮廓更加清晰。

    整栋小楼有两层高大门半掩着，门板上的木头已经朽烂了大半，门缝里透出一片漆黑。

    随后，陈峰走到楼外七八米的地方，便停下脚步。

    打量了几秒，并没有着急进去。

    大墟世界这么危险，到处都是异种生物，谁知道这栋小楼里面有没有其他怪物？

    陈峰琢磨了一下，

    弯腰捡起地上一块拳头大的碎石，朝着武馆大门里面甩了进去。

    砰！

    碎石在半空中划过一道弧线，随后落在武馆内的地面上，弹了两下，又滚出去老远，发出一连串的动静。

    陈峰竖起耳朵，仔细听了一会儿。

    一秒、两秒、三秒……似乎没有动静。

    他又捡起一块更大的石头，这次没往门里丢，而是砸在武馆外墙上。

    嘭！

    石头砸在水泥墙面上炸开碎渣四溅，发出一声巨大的动静。

    然而等了片刻，里面似乎还是没有传来异种生物的动静。

    陈峰心中稍稍放松，但他还是有些不放心，

    于是地上又摸了块碎石，这回用了七分力气直接朝门洞里扔了个高抛。

    石头飞进去在黑暗中划了一道弧线。

    啪嗒！

    武馆内骤然一静。

    过了两秒。
content_en:
The fog is getting thicker and thicker.

    Chen Feng held the engineering shovel and moved towards the west side step by step against the outer walls of the buildings along the street.

    The road ahead was in a state of disarray, with gravel and weeds intertwined together.

    Chen Feng had to be careful every step he took, for fear of making too much noise.

    After walking about sixty or seventy meters, a vague outline gradually emerged from the thick fog ahead. It was a two-story building.

    The entire small building is a bit shorter than the surrounding residential buildings. Large areas of white paint on the exterior walls have peeled off, revealing the dusty cement underneath.

    Chen Feng slowed down and looked forward through his goggles with squinted eyes.

    I saw a horizontal plaque hanging above the door of the small building. The plaque was crooked and only one end was still hanging on the nail. The other end was hanging down and swaying gently in the breeze.

    The words on the plaque were eroded by wind and rain, and there were no strokes or strokes, but a few words could still be vaguely discerned.

    【Liu's Martial Arts School】

    陈峰心跳微微加速。

    Found it, the martial arts gym mentioned by the middle school student in the diary is here.

    He took a few steps forward, and as the distance approached, the outline of the small building became clearer.

    The two-story-high door of the entire small building was ajar. Most of the wood on the door panel had rotted, and darkness shone through the crack in the door.

    Afterwards, Chen Feng stopped seven or eight meters outside the building.

    打量了几秒，并没有着急进去。

    The world of Daxu is so dangerous, with alien creatures everywhere. Who knows if there are other monsters in this small building?

    Chen Feng thought about it for a while.

    He bent down and picked up a fist-sized piece of gravel from the ground, and threw it into the door of the martial arts hall.

    Bang!

    The gravel drew an arc in mid-air, then landed on the ground in the martial arts hall, bounced twice, and then rolled far away, making a series of noises.

    陈峰竖起耳朵，仔细听了一会儿。

    One second, two seconds, three seconds... there seemed to be no movement.

    He picked up another bigger stone, and this time he didn't throw it into the door, but hit it on the outer wall of the martial arts hall.

    Bang!

    The stone hit the cement wall and exploded with debris flying everywhere, making a loud noise.

    However, after waiting for a while, there still seemed to be no movement of the alien creature inside.

    Chen Feng felt a little relieved, but he was still a little worried.

    So I touched another piece of gravel on the ground, and this time I used 70% of my strength to throw it directly into the doorway.

    石头飞进去在黑暗中划了一道弧线。

    Snap!

    There was a sudden silence in the martial arts hall.

    Two seconds passed.
